home.description: vibebud sits on top of your desktop, watching what your AI agents are doing on your behalf. it talks back in chat bubbles, taps you on the shoulder with toasts, and stays out of the way otherwise.

floating.title: floating avatar
floating.body: drag the buddy anywhere on screen. swap the avatar to whatever vibe matches your day.

chat.title: chat bubbles
chat.body: click to talk. ask what your agents are up to or kick off a new task.

toasts.title: toast pings
toasts.body: quietly surfaces PRs ready for review and moments that need your input.

home.tryBodyPrefix: click the buddy in the bottom-right. drag it around. hit

overlay.floatOnTop: float on top of my apps

todo.title: todo board
todo.subtitle: assign work to a buddy by choosing their avatar.
todo.createBuddyFirst: create a buddy first to assign tasks.

manage.title: manage avatars
manage.description: the personalities your buddies can wear. spawn one from the floating buddy menu, or create a custom one below.
manage.customEmptySubtitle: no custom avatars yet - create one to get started
manage.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Existing buddies using it will fall back to a built-in.

fields.name: name
fields.greetingHint: first message the buddy says when chat opens
fields.systemPromptHint: instructions sent to the LLM on every message

settings.title: App settings
settings.pairDescription: Routes Claude Code chats to a claude subprocess on your PC. On the desktop app, right-click any buddy -> Pair phone... to show the QR.
settings.scanUnavailable: In-app camera scan isn't available on this platform. Open vibebud://pair?... via your browser to pair.
settings.invalidHost: Not a valid host or URL.
settings.playDescription: Off-center grabs add spin in every mode - flick from the edge for a frisbee throw.

physics.bouncyDesc: Drag-and-fling to send buddies sailing - they bounce off edges and bump into each other.
physics.astronautDesc: Zero-g drift: buddies float and spin endlessly, ricocheting off everything.
physics.wonderDesc: Shimeji-style wandering: characters walk, sit, fall, and climb while staying draggable.

settings.rotateDescription: Off-center grabs swing the avatar; flicks add spin. Disable to keep avatars upright at all times.
settings.collectionDescription: Levels, daily tasks, bond, milestones, and team stats.
settings.notificationsDescription: Where pings show up - agent dispatched, PR ready, needs your input, etc.
settings.inAppToastDesc: Card slides up next to the buddy. Only visible while the buddy window is on screen.
settings.nativeElectronDesc: Windows Action Center / macOS Notification Center.
settings.androidPermissionHint: Android hasn't granted notification permission yet. Tap below to open the permission prompt or app settings.
settings.browserPermissionHint: Notification permission isn't granted by your browser/OS.

collection.title: Collection
collection.subtitle: Daily goals and buddy growth
collection.teamsEmpty: Group buddies and complete an agent task to start tracking teams.
